author: shadow
name: Kerrigan
short: Casual staff moderation assistant that works with VoidSanction.
description: Allows staff to ping the bot with casual sentences containing a moderation action and user. Parses the request, optionally confirms, then executes via VoidSanction. Supports duration, soft theme toggle, and message cleanup. Configurable per server. Void cog recommended for void/nullvoid.
install_msg: Thanks for adding this cog. Load VoidSanction (and Void for full void/nullvoid support). Configure with [p]kerriganset.
